title: Validation rehearsal
text: Rehearsal applies item-declared migrations only to the separately bound validation database and records durable control-plane receipts. Before the first apply, it retains one private archive of that exact validation database and commits and verifies each module's migration_audit.backup_path; a missing archive or receipt refuses mutation; a failed pre-count or archive dump refuses naming its step and the dump's password-scrubbed stderr; and the restore point remains bound through apply, invariants and verification commands. Attested commands run after each module with its exact identifier in reserved YOKE_MIGRATION_REHEARSAL_MODULE, replacing inherited context; module-specific commands validate it before using the copy, while fleet callbacks run after complete convergence. A selected source worker must be an active registered lane of the named item, authorized by the caller's matching item or task claim. Invalid source bindings refuse with rehearsal_source_lane_invalid and recovery; without a binding the ordinary item-lane default wins over cwd. A source lane re-enters as yoke dev run -- yoke --env <name> migration rehearse ITEM; --env placed before dev run is refused with use_https_env. A DB claim's rehearsal_commands are test commands; listing the rehearse command there makes rehearsal call itself and fail.
